notes: The lamp moved to the cabin's front shoulder so no drill, collar, armour or tool frame covers it; rig-cabin draws it unlit and rig-cabin-emissive lit (ADD above the darkness; its lens ring is the lit colour minus the unlit lens, so only the bulb core reaches white). The rank-0 armour is the band's yellow skirt plate. The drill bit's flute grooves move three pitches over the 8 frames (DRILL_FLUTE_TURNS); the down drill and collar carry their own top-lit tiers. Every tier fill reaches the screen at @4 in its own frame (scripts/art_tiers.py visible_svg_tiers). icon-energy and icon-feet follow the reworked generators; icon-drill, icon-cargo, icon-hull, icon-engine and icon-rack keep their pre-A13 drawings.
